title: Game-Theoretic Inspection Game Equilibria for Setting Audit Rates

original_idea.body:
# Game-Theoretic Inspection Game Equilibria for Setting Audit Rates

**Problem:** How often should a blue team audit an untrusted agent? The optimal rate is a strategic, not heuristic, choice.

**Direction:** Import the economics inspection game. Formalize blue-team audit probability vs red-team sabotage probability, solve for mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium given measured cost and catch probability, then validate the predicted deterrence threshold against simulated agents in ControlArena.

**Why it matters:** Gives a principled, incentive-aware audit rate, and predicts when sparse auditing still deters. Theory plus light simulation, no training.

**Relevant context:** Inspection games (Avenhaus); The Oversight Game (arXiv:2510.26752); Redwood AI Control.
